posts.author: Muichiro_Tokito
posts.body:
Hey everyone, so for my project, I've gathered a TON of volunteers to Voice Act in my game. Because RPG MAKER MV unfortunately doesn't have any "Voice Acting" volume settings or anything like that, I've resorted to finding plugins for voice acting! I found MogHunter's BattleCry voice acting plugin, which I've been using for quite some time (It's acting like Octopath Travelers Voice Acting Style, which I like!). But I wanted to ask if anyone could maybe help with sorting these issues I've found during my time testing and using this plugin. If there isn't really a fix, then it's okay. I figured I'd ask and see what this lovely community can come up with! So these are the problems I've found during my time testing the plugin and voice lines!
1. Healing Lines - The healing lines play perfectly fine in battle, but when players use healing outside of battle, the voice lines will play, and healing a single actor may not be bad, but if you're also healing ALL actors at the same time, it might just feel off. I never really had much of a solution to this issue, and this is a bit of an iffy ask for a fix, and yes, the healing lines all play at the same time, so it might get irritating when you hear several voice lines go off, haha.
2. Death Lines - For some reason, the Death Lines quite literally don't play at all. I thought maybe because the Voice Files are SE's that the Sound Effect for when Actors collapse plays it also cancels out the Death Lines, so I turned it off, but it didn't seem to work either.​
Overall, these are my TWO major issues; everything else is working just fine. Any help would be lovely, and thank you for your time and for helping me solve or come up with these issues, I genuienly, appreicate it <3. If there isn't anything anyone can do no worries at all, I will just have to pray players deal with these problems X_X
Also, here is the plugin file in case you need it! (don't mind the SE files already placed in the voice files)

posts.author: Erif
posts.body:
I can help you on the first one.
If the plugin is still unmodified, go to the function itemEffectRecoverHp and replace the last line before the }; with
Code:
if (old_hp <= target.hp && $gameParty.inBattle()) {SoundManager.selectVoice(target._v_recover)};
